page.overview:
Who is Movo Brattakin?

Movo Brattakin was an acquaintance of Olag Greck. After Greck nearly murdered him, Movo merged his mind with the metallic body of his aide B-9D7. He then reprogrammed C-3PO to lead a droid rebellion to topple Boonda the Hutt, allying himself with R2-D2 in order to join the rebellion and gain access to Boonda's facilities. However, Artoo discovered his true identity and was able to keep Brattakin occupied long enough for him to be shot by Jace Forno, his former henchwoman who objected to a droid giving her orders, even if it had a Human brain.
